Homepage navigation clearly distinguishes academic training, research programs, patient support, career and grant opportunities, and news. These sections receive explicit routing; no personal-story series is evidenced for a stories rule.

rules.rationale: The patient-information section provides practical health and care guidance rather than academic program descriptions.
Careers and grant information describe employment and funding opportunities; the grant override precedes general research routing.
The education section explicitly contains residency, fellowship, undergraduate and graduate training programs.
The research and clinical program sections describe urologic research areas, institutes and trials rather than degree curricula.
The homepage explicitly links an Events & News section and displays institutional announcements.
These homepage article titles announce awards, new trainees and awarded research funding; they are not open funding calls or personal-story interviews.
rules.title_pattern: ^(?:Dr\. S\. Larry Goldenberg honoured|Dr\. Ryan Flannigan receives|Meet our New Fellows and Residents|UBC Urologic Sciences researchers receive|Dr\. Gillian Vandekerkhove Awarded)

fallback.rationale: The host represents a university medical academic department and its institutional educational context; explicit rules separate research, patient support, opportunities and news.
